info.title: Glacier Distributed Cluster CLI (glacier-distributed) - Pure C# .NET
info.description: Command-line interface (glacier-distributed) for the Glacier Distributed MoE Cluster. Launches heterogeneous pipeline coordinators and worker daemons across LAN nodes.

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to GGUF model file (e.g. Qwen2-57B or Mixtral-8x22B)

options.name: --stages
options.description: Comma-separated list of candidate worker endpoints

options.name: --layers
options.description: Layer allocation policy (e.g. 'auto' or '8,14,6' or '7,7,7,7')

options.name: --host-gpu
options.description: Direct3D 12 adapter index for Host (default: auto fastest VRAM)

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Text prompt for inference generation

options.name: --tokens
options.description: Maximum new tokens to generate (default: -1 unlimited)

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Keep session alive for multi-turn chat

options.name: --cache
options.description:
Directory to store stage slices (default: ./models/cache)
Directory to store received stage slices (default: ./models/cache)

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port to listen on (default: 5055)

options.name: --http-port
options.description: HTTP port to listen on (default: 8080)

options.name: --host
options.description: Host address to bind HTTP server (default: 0.0.0.0)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Require Bearer token or x-api-key authentication (or set GLACIER_API_KEY)
